mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 5% and FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%, the market perceives inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to stagflation risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 105.0), industrial production declines signal weakening corporate earnings and economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1200.0) signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through housing sector GDP contributions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 6.0% triggers immediate equity sell-offs as the market anticipates aggressive Fed rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 6.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS MoM > 0.5%) coincides with weak consumer spending (RSAFS MoM < 0.3%), the economy faces a consumption-labor mismatch that triggers negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS MoM > 0.5% and RSAFS MoM < 0.3% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), economic momentum supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as the business cycle peaks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0% over any 5-year rolling window.
